description.value: Sabhai Thai is a family-owned authentic Thai restaurant on Sidney's main commercial strip, open since 2006 and voted #1 ethnic food restaurant in Sidney for multiple consecutive years by the Peninsula News Review Reader's Choice Awards. The menu is made entirely from scratch using traditional Thai recipes and ingredients sourced in part from a family business in Thailand. A second location operates in Langford, but the Sidney spot on Beacon Avenue is the original.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 35m; stands (10 spaces) at 42m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sabhai.ca confirms the Sidney location at 2493 Beacon Avenue with phone 250-655-4085, matching OSM exactly. The site explicitly states 'a variety of dishes to choose from for everyone, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan meals' and OSM carries takeaway=yes, corroborated by a prominent 'Order Online' link on the website. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom details appear anywhere in the website text or OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: The reviews and employment pages have been heavily spammed with Russian/bot trackback comments, suggesting the WordPress site has not been actively moderated — the underlying business appears active regardless.
OSM opening hours for Sidney dinner differ slightly from the website (OSM: Tu-Th 16:00-20:30; website: Tu-Th/Su 4:00-8:00 PM) — minor discrepancy worth flagging but not recorded here per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, well-established restaurant that a touring cyclist would benefit from, but none of the required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least bike parking or visibility before accreditation.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website covers two locations (Sidney and Langford); this OSM record and listing apply to the Sidney location only.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'a variety of dishes to choose from for everyone, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan meals.' Lunch menu includes a dedicated vegetarian Phad Thai (L combo C) and a vegetarian spring roll combo

wow_evidence: voted #1 ethnic food restaurant in Sidney for multiple consecutive years by the Peninsula News Review Reader's Choice Awards
